name: HuggingFace Platform
description: Hugging Face Hub - A platform for hosting and sharing AI models, particularly for natural language processing, computer vision, and other machine learning tasks. Supports models from various frameworks including Transformers, Diffusers, and more.

specCharacteristic.name: platformUrl
specCharacteristic.description: Base URL for the Hugging Face Hub platform

specCharacteristic.name: apiUrl
specCharacteristic.description: Base URL for the Hugging Face API

specCharacteristic.name: supportedModelTypes
specCharacteristic.description: Types of models supported by the platform

specCharacteristic.name: supportedLibraries
specCharacteristic.description: Machine learning libraries supported by the platform

specCharacteristic.name: licenseTypes
specCharacteristic.description: Types of licenses available on the platform

specCharacteristic.name: accessTypes
specCharacteristic.description: Model access levels supported by the platform

characteristicValueSpecification.value: Each model provides a deploymentArtifactsUrl characteristic that points to a tar.gz archive containing all essential files needed for deployment (config, tokenizer, weights, etc.). Archives are created on-demand and served via the TMF API.
